steps: This "date" is actually kinda fun... Oh no! I forgot all about the mission!
The brand-new drinks inside the Artifact held Cosette's gaze like a magnet.
But Cosette still doesn't seem to have let her guard down around the vending Artifact. She's eying the machine up and down with a wary look.
No need to be so cautious. The box is not gonna move.
It feels cold and solid. And it smells faintly metallic.
Mhm... Even though it really does look like a Stellaroid, it probably isn't. Just an ordinary Artifact.
Told you, right? Take a look. See any Monolith drinks in there you've never seen before?
Ah,==W== Boss! Look!==W== This yogurt-flavored soda!==W== It's super good!
It's not as heavy as yogurt==W== but sour and refreshing,==W== and it's amazing when chilled!==W== Anyway,==W== it's perfect for a hot day!
Oh, and==W== this honey-flavored one is only available in certain regions.==W== You won't find it anywhere else!
The sweetness is just right!==W== It has a smooth texture==W== that's easy to swallow.==W== Even better,==W== just one sip==W== will wash all your worries away!

Huh?!==W== If you take a closer look,==W== there's even the passion fruit special?!==W== This one==W== is super—duper—==W==sour!!!==W== The first time I had it...==W== I didn't know its flavor,==W== so I took a huge gulp…

Guess what...==W== Ugh...!==W== Even if I just think about it==W==, I can feel...==W== from my mouth straight into my belly,==W== that sourness burst out in one go...==W== It was so strong,==W== I had to curl up into a ball…!
… Oops.==W== S-==W==Sorry!==W== When I see beverages,==W== I just lose control...
Though==W== these flavors are a bit weird,==W== every single one is so,==W== so good~
Huh?==W== That packaging on top...==W== I've never seen it before!==W== It's…==W== It's a new one!
Boss,==W== would you like to try out==W== all flavors I recommended?
Wait, wait, that's too much for us.
I'll just try the yogurt one!
All the drinks are inside the big box. How do we get them out?
You just put a coin in here, pick the one you want, press the button, and the drink drops out on its own.
Hmm...? Why isn't it doing anything?==W== Is it ... broken?!
No way... I definitely put the money in—it should be working.
Hey,==W== hey.==W== Nope, still nothing's coming out.
How could this happen...==W== I was really looking forward to sharing it with you, ==PLAYER_NAME==...
Don't tell me it really is broken.
Why are you being so serious all of a sudden?
Please close your eyes for a second. What I'm about to do may be ...==W== slightly inappropriate.
Ah—what are you doing? You're not planning on...?
No, you aren't my target, Boss.
She's not thinking about destroying the machine, is she...?
Cosette smacks the top of the vending Artifact at a perfect forty-five-degree angle.
Phew... Just like what the book said...!
I had no idea one could do that... What kind of book did you get that from this time?
I found a book called Tips for City Living. It said if an Artifact breaks down, just give it a good smack from a 45-degree angle, then it'll start working again!
I-I see. That's weird ... but kinda useful, actually.
But I still don't think it's good to smash things.That's why I wanted you to close your eyes, ==PLAYER_NAME==.
You said it out loud, so of course I know now... Well, I guess that honesty is part of her charm, too.
Here you go, ==PLAYER_NAME==. This bottle of yogurt's on me.
Consider this a thank-you for teaching me how to use the vending Artifact.
Alright then. Cheers to our fun date today~

"Clean-up" Log, Day 100. ==P== Today, Boss and I found a mysterious "Automatic Vending Artifact." It had all kinds of Monolith drinks I'd never seen before. ==P== The reality of dating is somewhat different from what the book described.
Wait, the date...==W== What was I supposed to be doing again...?
Oh no, oh no—today's mission was to figure out Boss's special ability... Which I didn't do at all!
But now that I think about it, even though I didn't find anything out about ==SEX3==, ==SEX== probably didn't catch on to what I was trying to do, either.
So in the end, I did manage to keep Boss busy and waste a whole day of ==SEX3== life, thereby slowing down ==SEX3== plan to destroy the world.
If I keep this up long enough, sooner or later, I'll get Boss to completely waste ==SEX3== life.
Perfect. That's what I'll write in my report to Lady Aeloria. She should be pleased with that.
After jotting down the report, Cosette pulls out the last drink she bought today while saying goodbye to Boss.
When should I ask Boss out again?...==W== How about...
